curated_items.title: Codex CLI Release: 0.164.0
curated_items.summary: New Features Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered /presets slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. ( #54380 , #54381 ) Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline /model and /permissions arguments. ( #54378 , #54383 ) Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. ( #54216 ) Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. ( #55334 , #55859 , #56001 ) Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers.
